name: Khan Hratha
summary: In Desolace, Warug sets his sights on Khan Hratha after the Gelkis Khan's death. He sends you to face the Maraudine Khan and return with the piece of a key he carries.

sections.title: A Horn on the Bluff
sections.body: Warug wants Khan Hratha, the Maraudine Khan, dead. A horn on a bluff in the Valley of Spears will draw him out, but first you need its mouthpiece from a Maraudine centaur. Sound the horn and Maraudine centaur gather at the tower. Hratha appears after them.

sections.title: A Piece of a Key
sections.body: Khan Hratha carries part of a key, and Warug wants you to bring it to him in Magram Village. He expects you to prove yourself an ally of the Magram.

sections.title: Masters of the Centaur
sections.body: With Khan Hratha dead, Warug declares the Magram the mightiest of the centaur. He says they are destined to crush their rivals and rule Desolace. Warug promises you will be remembered and spared when the rest are trampled.

faq.q: Who sends you to defeat Khan Hratha?
faq.answer: Warug sends you from Magram Village in Desolace after the Gelkis Khan's death.

faq.q: How do you reach Khan Hratha?
faq.answer: To face Hratha, sound the horn on the bluff in the Valley of Spears. First, take its mouthpiece from a Maraudine centaur. The centaur gather at the tower, and Hratha appears after them.
Hratha appears at the tower in the Valley of Spears after the horn sounds and the Maraudine centaur gather there.
Hratha carries part of a key, which Warug asks you to bring to him.
